name: Fleet replenishment oiler
note: Generic fleet replenishment oiler - a representative stand-in (in the class of the US John Lewis (T-AO-205) or Supply-class), not a specific ship. Unarmed auxiliary that carries fuel, ammunition and stores for underway replenishment; typically operates one or two helicopters. All figures are estimates.
